name: My Purpose In Life
overview: Scripture reveals that God has a sovereign purpose for each life, raising individuals to display His power and declare His name throughout the earth, as seen in Exodus 9:16. Believers are called to commit their ways to the Lord and trust Him to fulfill His plans (Psalms 37:5), aligning their hearts with His counsel (Psalms 20:4). The Lord’s purpose includes guiding His people to live justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him (Micah 6:8), promising a hopeful and peaceful future (Jeremiah 29:11) that begins with faithful training and instruction from youth (Proverbs 22:6).
